svg.title: Native repair information flow
svg.desc: Native repair information flow. The model proposes a query; the host runs the parent and reference programs and compares their answers. Outputs and errors inform the model's proposed replacement code. Outcomes also inform further queries in adaptive conditions only; repair-only omits new queries. The host replays development cases and selects the parent or repair. Only the selected, frozen source passes into held-out evaluation. Held-out outcomes do not return to query proposals, repair or selection.
